title: Twisting a relatively ample sheaf by a pullback of an ample sheaf
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that twisting a relatively ample invertible sheaf by a sufficiently high power of the pullback of an ample invertible sheaf gives an ample sheaf, and that the pullback of an ample sheaf along a quasi-affine morphism is ample. The proof first collects separatedness of the source and target from ampleness and relative ampleness, then works point by point: it chooses a section of a power of the ample sheaf whose nonvanishing locus is affine and contains the image of the point, then a section of a power of the relatively ample sheaf whose nonvanishing locus inside that affine piece is affine, and uses the standard criterion to produce the required section of a twisted power giving an affine neighbourhood.
